headline: A2 Milk Shares Fall 8% After 2027 Earnings Guidance Disappoints
summary: Shares of A2 Milk fell 8% after the company warned its first-half revenue is expected to be slightly lower year-on-year, lowering its full-year 2027 earnings outlook.
why: The A2 Milk Company is a major New Zealand exporter of infant formula and dairy products into Asian markets.

impacts.name: The A2 Milk Company
impacts.why: Disappointing first-half revenue guidance triggered an 8% drop in the company's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Revenue warnings for the upcoming half year caused investors to revise earnings forecasts downward.
